paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Initial Confidence and Accuracy, comparing three types of accuracy: Final Acc, Δ Acc, and Initial Acc. The x-axis represents Initial Confidence, with a linear scale ranging from 0.95 to 0.99, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis represents Accuracy, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three lines: Final Acc, a blue solid line with square markers, starts at approximately 0.87 and decreases to around 0.86; Δ Acc, an orange dashed line with diamond markers, starts at approximately 0.88 and decreases to around 0.78; Initial Acc, a green dash-dot line with square markers, starts at approximately 0.01 and increases to around 0.12.
